pricing.title: Pay for contacts, not for features
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes templates, automation and reports. You pay for list size.
pricing.note: Prices are placeholders until final pricing is set. All plans include the 14 day free trial.

items.q: How long is the free trial?
items.a: The trial lasts 14 days and includes all Growth features. You do not need a credit card to start it.

items.q: Can I import my current list?
items.a: Yes. Upload a CSV file. Invalid addresses are flagged, and unsubscribed contacts stay unsubscribed.

items.q: Will my emails land in spam?
items.a: Mailcraft checks your sender setup before the first send and guides you through domain checks step by step.
A series of emails that sends itself when something happens, like a signup, a purchase, or a quiet month.

items.q: Can I test two subject lines?
items.a: Yes. Growth plans include A/B tests. The winning subject goes to the rest of the list automatically.
A segment is a saved filter, like past buyers or readers who clicked last month. Send to a segment instead of the whole list.
Yes. The interface and the email editor are fully bilingual, Arabic and English, including right to left layouts.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: You keep your lists and campaigns and move to the free Starter limits, or pick a paid plan. Nothing is deleted.
